items.problem: The UWP manifest Application EntryPoint remained and the migrated package could not activate.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md was fetched in turn 8, but Package.appxmanifest still used EntryPoint="NfcProvisioner.App"; turns 24-40 and migration-score.json show Arg_COMException activation failure.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, Project File Updates > Manifest migration checklist, item 4
items.proposed_improvement: Enforce the existing EntryPoint="$targetentrypoint$" requirement in Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 so the long manifest checklist cannot be partially applied.
items.generalizes: Every packaged UWP-to-WinUI migration starts with a UWP App-class entry point and must retain the scaffold's generated WinUI entry-point placeholder.
